questions.text: I consistently follow through on important commitments.
questions.comment: Future You is currently cross-checking this with your calendar.

questions.text: I spend more time taking action than planning.
questions.comment: Writing lists of lists does not count as action. Just a heads up.
Future You would appreciate it if we didn't buy that mechanical keyboard.

questions.text: I prioritize my health even when life gets busy.
questions.comment: Yes, sleeping count counts. Also eating things that aren't pizza.

questions.text: I know what my biggest goals are.
questions.comment: Vague goals like 'be successful' make Dr. Tomorrow cry.

questions.text: I spend time every week working toward those goals.
questions.comment: Thinking about them while scrolling is not 'working toward'.

questions.text: I avoid distractions when I need to focus.
questions.comment: Are you opening another tab right now? We see you.

questions.text: I make decisions instead of endlessly researching.
questions.comment: The 84th review video of that laptop is probably redundant.

questions.text: I keep promises I make to myself.
questions.comment: This is the core foundation of your alignment. Be honest.

questions.text: I regularly invest in learning and growth.
questions.comment: Buying courses you never open doesn't count. Actually opening them does.
R.I.P. to the 12 unfinished code repositories in your folders.
Scroll loops are a temporal black hole. Avoid them.

questions.text: I am building habits that support the life I want.
questions.comment: Small daily stacks become massive timeline gains.

questions.text: I take responsibility for my results.
questions.comment: Blaming the algorithm is standard, but ineffective.

questions.text: I would be proud if my next five years looked exactly like my last five years.
questions.comment: The big final question. Take a breath. This is why we are here.
